subject: Draft MAP: retention sprint & evidence gating for PHI/PII
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MAP items for data retention + evidence gating (action items)

Hi team — thanks again for the call earlier. Per request from Veridian, I captured the MAP items we need to surface to get to a procurement decision. Pulling this into a short list to confirm owners and dates before I push the draft MAP to Sam/Angela.

Key ask from Veridian: they need explicit commitments and sample evidence for retention, logging, and audit trails (PHI in scope).

Proposed milestones (high level):
- M1 (Info): Confirm retention windows for user-generated text + embeddings (owner: Redwood Security/Product). Target: 2026-10-21
- M2 (Evidence): Provide sample audit trail (anonymized) demonstrating tenant-scoped event logs and KMS key usage. Owner: Redwood Security. Target: 2026-10-23
- M3 (Controls): Document PHI handling constraints and masking/segregation approach; include exceptions and emergency access flow. Owner: Product Compliance. Target: 2026-10-26
- M4 (Contract): DPA clause redline & signature readiness. Owner: Sales & Legal. Target: 2026-10-30

Dependencies: SOC 2 report excerpt, example audit log export, and confirmation on whether Veridian requires on-prem/private deployment for PHI.

Attachments: proposed-MAP-retention-evidence-v1.docx (draft MAP), retention-matrix-veridian.xlsx (initial mapping).

Next steps (please reply with one-line owner confirmations and whether the targets look realistic):
- Marissa: can you own M2 (sample audit trail) and coordinate with Security?
- Ben: can you take M4 (DPA redline cadence) and sync Legal?

Sam/Angela — we’ll share a formal MAP doc once internal owners confirm. If you can share any mandatory retention windows or audit formats (CSV vs JSON), add here and I’ll align the matrix.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP items for data retention + evidence gating (action items)

Vanessa — happy to take M2. Quick notes:
- I’ll coordinate with Security (I'll loop in their alias in the next message).
- For the sample audit trail we will provide an anonymized export of: request_id, timestamp, model_id, tenant_id (hashed), action_type (generate/embeddings), kv-cache events, and KMS key id usages. Format: JSON newline-delimited + a small CSV extract.
- ETA: I can produce a first-pass sample by 2026-10-23 but will mark it as REVIEW_ONLY (redacted PHI).

Action: Vanessa, I’ll need confirmation on whether Veridian expects daily retention reporting or point-in-time retention windows (policy). Sam — does Veridian require retention reporting cadence or just retention duration commitments?

Marissa Cole
Product Security Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

From: Sam Park <sam.park@veridianhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@veridianhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP items for data retention + evidence gating (action items)

Thanks Vanessa & Marissa — quick clarifications from our side so we align expectations:
- Retention windows: we need the ability to set per-tenant retention for PHI-derived tokens. Default policy is 7 years for PHI, but we have a subset of data that needs 10-year retention. We don’t expect daily reporting; a policy commitment + ability to produce retention attestations on request is sufficient.
- Audit format: prefer newline-delimited JSON; a CSV summary is fine for procurement review.
- Volume: PHI tokens are limited (pilot ~120K tokens/week), but we will scale. Can you confirm whether snapshot exports will include KMS key identifiers and whether key usage is tenant-scoped?

Also, procurement (Angela) flagged that the DPA redline needs to call out retention start date (ingest vs. processed output) — we can share a draft clause.

Sam Park
Director, Data Governance | Veridian Health
sam.park@veridianhealth.com | +1 617-555-0812

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@veridianhealth.com>, Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP items for data retention + evidence gating (action items)

Looping Legal: I’ll set up a DPA redline cadence and ask Legal to pre-clear the evidence package. A couple of practical asks from our side:
- Can Security provide a one-pager on KMS tenant scoping and key lifecycle (rotate/retire)? That will speed Legal review.
- For the sample audit trail, mark any export as "demonstrative only" and include a short readme that explains the redaction approach.

I’ll propose the following internal milestones and owners (slightly rephrased):
- Evidence pack (M2): owner Marissa — deliver sample logs + readme by 2026-10-23
- KMS & key scope note (M2.1): owner Security — PPT one-pager by 2026-10-22
- DPA redline (M4): owner Ben (Sales) with Legal — initial redline 2026-10-25, target sign by 2026-10-30

Vanessa — I’m free for a quick 20-min sync Monday to align Legal notes before we send to Veridian.

Ben Carter
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com | +1 212-555-0144

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@veridianhealth.com>, Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Oct 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft MAP + next steps (attached)

Sam/Angela — attaching the draft MAP and retention matrix (proposed-MAP-retention-evidence-v1.docx, retention-matrix-veridian.xlsx). Highlights:
- We committed to per-tenant retention configuration (defaults + override for 10yr PHI).
- Evidence pack will include NDJSON audit sample + CSV summary and a short readme explaining redaction and tenant hashing.
- KMS usage will be represented in the export as key_id (non-secret); key lifecycle note included.

Please review sections 2.1 (Retention windows) and 3.2 (Audit artifacts) and comment directly in the doc — I’ve left placeholders where Legal/Procurement should add DPA requirements.

Target close: we proposed 2026-10-30 in the MAP to align with Veridian’s procurement window; if that looks tight, flag alternative dates and we’ll update owners.

Next meeting: I’ll send a calendar invite for 2026-10-19 10:00 PT for a 30-min sync with Product Security and Procurement to walk the evidence pack and DPA asks.

Thanks all —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com
Attachments: data-handling-checklist.pdf (summary), proposed-MAP-retention-evidence-v1.docx, retention-matrix-veridian.xlsx
